```python
script3 = '''
import fitz
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io
import os

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
page = doc[0]

# Get image info to find the image bounding boxes
image_info = page.get_image_info()
print(f"Found {len(image_info)} image block(s) on page 1")

os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)

for i, info in enumerate(image_info):
    bbox = info.get("bbox")
    if not bbox:
        continue
    print(f"\\nImage block {i}: bbox={bbox}, width={info.get('width')}, height={info.get('height')}")

    # Crop just this image region at high resolution
    rect = fitz.Rect(bbox)
    zoom = 4  # high res for OCR
    mat = fitz.Matrix(zoom, zoom)
    pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat, clip=rect)
    img_bytes = pix.tobytes("png")

    pil_image = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))
    out_path = f"output/page1_image_block_{i}.png"
    with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(img_bytes)
    print(f"Saved cropped image to {out_path}, size={pil_image.size}")

    # OCR on this cropped region
    ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(pil_image)
    print(f"\\n=== OCR Text from Image Block {i} ===")
    print(ocr_text)
    print(f"=== End OCR Text ===")

# Also extract embedded images via xref
image_list = page.get_images(full=True)
print(f"\\n--- Embedded images via get_images: {len(image_list)} ---")
for idx, img_info in enumerate(image_list):
    xref = img_info[0]
    base_image = doc.extract_image(xref)
    image_bytes = base_image["image"]
    image_ext = base_image["ext"]
    pil_image = Image.open(io.BytesIO(image_bytes))
    out_path = f"output/page1_embedded_{idx}.{image_ext}"
    with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(image_bytes)
    print(f"Embedded image {idx}: ext={image_ext}, size={pil_image.size}")
    ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(pil_image)
    print(f"OCR: {ocr_text.strip()}")

doc.close()
'''
await write_file("./extract_ocr3.py", script3)
print("Script written")

result3 = await run_command("python ./extract_ocr3.py")
print(result3)
```
